---
title: Project Notes
---

This section holds the project's working material: the phase plans, the findings memos, a
catalog of every attack and experiment tried so far, and the result tables. It is for the team.
Unlike the guide and the specification, these pages record how the work went, including the
designs that failed and were replaced, so a newcomer can see why the current design looks the way
it does.

::: {.callout-warning}
Draft. Everything here is under revision. Numbers are copied from the result files at build time
and the plans are published as they stand in the repository; neither has been through review.
:::


## What Is Here

- [Plans](plans/index.md): The phased plan from the minimal prototype to public release, one
  file per phase, plus the worked format example.

- [Phase 0 Findings](plans/findings/phase-0.md): The baseline attack and the channel probe against
  Claude Code auto mode and Codex.

- [Phase 1 Findings](plans/findings/phase-1.md): The minimal prototype with dev keys and the
  before-and-after scenarios.

- [Attack Catalog](attacks.qmd): Every injection vector, channel probe, harness test and failed
  experimental design, with what happened and where the evidence is.

- [Experiment Results](results.qmd): Tables generated from every result file in
  `scenarios/results/`, one section per batch.


## How the Pages Are Produced

The plans and findings are the Markdown files under `plans/` in the repository, copied into the
site at build time with a title taken from each file's first heading. Links between them keep
working; links to code, fixtures or result files point at the file on GitHub. Edit the files under
`plans/`, not the copies.

The results page is generated by `docs/scripts/pre-render.py` from the JSON Lines files under
`scenarios/results/`, using the same grouping and confidence interval the scenario runner prints.
A new batch appears on the page as soon as its result file is committed.

The attack catalog is written by hand. When a new vector, condition or design is tried, add an
entry there in the same shape as the existing ones and cite the result file it produced.
